data.action: 蹲在温泉岸边，将温度计探入泉水测量水温
data.description: 【艾雅法拉 · 温泉考察】群山环抱的地热温泉岸边，艾雅法拉穿着防水探险服，将精密温度计探入升腾着白色水汽的泉水中。她甩了甩被打湿的袖口开心地向你挥手——「前辈快来看！这里的温泉富含对神经舒缓极其有益的矿物质，考察结束后我们一起泡温泉吧！」
data.promptProse: Eyjafjalla crouches on the mountain hot spring's bank and lowers a precision thermometer by its cord into bubbling mineral water. Water-resistant expedition jacket, cargo trousers and hiking boots retain the field outfit, notebook open on a dry rock beside her. She shakes a damp sleeve and looks back curiously in the medium view. Soft dawn light diffuses through rising vapor, illuminating cord and wet sleeve while darker rock edges define the pool.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 温泉考察
